titleEn: Law on Revision of the 2009 Law on Financial Management

articles.en:
..
Investment projects which have adequate qualifications in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors shall be entitled to an incentive in the form of a priority period of exemption from tax on profit for three (3) years. Investment activities in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors that are entitled to this incentive shall be determined by sub-decree and by the implementation of the Law on Investment.

..
All provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

..
- This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at the Royal Palace, Phnom Penh, 00 [illegible] 2009; signed and sealed: Norodom Sihamoni.
Having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Economy and Finance.
